how1: Nyora zvavanenge vachitenga (kana kubaya 🍚 Rice, 20 lb bag yemitengo chaiyo yemusika).
how2: Isa mutengo weimwe muUnited States (kana kudzvanya chip).
how3: Sarudza kuti mumwe nemumwe anowana mangani.
how4: Wedzera mumwe nemumwe anogamuchira: tora iyo nyika, wedzera zita / rudo.
how5: Mutsara wega wega unoratidza zvekutumira; nyora mutengo chaiwo wepano kana uchizviziva.
how6: Zvose zviri pasi; tap Kopa hurongwa hwekugovera.
how7: Kana kuti vhura rondedzero yekushuvira: sarudza zvavanoda, kopira chinyorwa, wobva wapa kuburikidza nepeji remishoni.
howp: Izvi zvinoronga mari. Hachitumiri mari kana kuona masangano anobatsira. Ipa kuburikidza peji yega yega yepamutemo peji.
tagline: Ipa kuti mumwe nemumwe atenge zvakafanana.
nosend: App iyi haitumire mari kana kuona vanopa rubatsiro. Ipa kuburikidza peji yega yega yepamutemo peji.
about1: Matengo emitengo anobva kuWorld Bank (mutengo wekushandisa wepamba, kazhinji 2024; US = zana, yakachengetwa se1.0). Mari dzekuchinjana dziripo nhasi. Mari yepamutemo yenyika = Mari yeUS × yayo 2024 yemhuri PPP, yakashandurwa kuita madhora pachiyero chanhasi. Mitengo yepamutemo mutengo wekurarama, kwete chinhu chimwe chegirosari uye kwete mutengo wanhasi wemawaya. Nyora mutengo kana iwo chaiwo uchizivikanwa (unoratidzwa se "mutengo wako").
about2: inoshandisa mitengo chaiyo yemupunga pamusika pachinzvimbo cheyero yemutengo: US kubva kuBureau of Labor Statistics (series APU0000701312, US city average), Haiti neMalawi kubva kuWorld Food Program (kuburikidza neHDX). Mitengo yemuno inoshandurwa kuita madhora pachiyero chemazuva ano. 20 lb = 9.07 kg. Nyika dzisina mutengo wemupunga wemusika dzinoshandisa mwero wemutengo.
about3: Mitengo yezvishuwo ndeye World Food Programme yekutengesa mitengo yemusika (kuburikidza neHDX) yenzvimbo yemishini, nemusika uye mwedzi zvichiratidzwa pane chimwe nechimwe chinhu. Zvinhu zvisina mutengo wemusika zvinoti "mutengo wakaiswa nemishoni".
sentence: United States inotumirwa {a} ( {b} × {n} ). Imwe neimwe nzvimbo inotumirwa yayo mutengo inopeta nhamba imwe chete iyoyo.
rates_unavail: ⚠ Mareti ekurarama haasipo — uchishandisa World Bank 2024 mareti nemitengo.
machine_note: Shanduro dzakagadzirwa nemuchina. Chirungu ndicho chekutanga.
wl_intro: Mamisheni haakwanise kuunza mapakeji; vanotenga pamusika wavo vega. Sarudza izvo basa rinoda, wobva wapa kuburikidza nepeji rayo neinoti pazasi kuti mari itenge zvinhu izvi munharaunda.
wl_give_hint: Kopa kanoti, dzvanya Ipa zvakananga, uye unamate munoti yechipo kana memo bhokisi.
wl_shared_warn: Yakagovaniswa wishlist: yakagadzirwa nechero atumira chinongedzo. Tarisa iyo yekupa link ndiro peji rechokwadi remishini.
wl_m_items: Zvinhu, imwe pamutsara: zita | mutengo wemunharaunda (siya mutengo usina chinhu kana ukachinja)
wl_bad: Wedzera zita, https:// link uye chinhu chimwe chete.
